divergences.spec: core §7.4（debug §1「describe の channel_group / role_channels が候補を宣言する。」）: 両方を書いた場合、選んだピンの組は channel_group のどれかに一致し、かつ role_channels の候補にも入っていなければならない。
divergences.fix: the bench allows a pair only when it matches one channel_group (roles it lists) and role_channels (roles it lists), a role named by neither not allowed; the client candidate pairs apply the same rule (group role from role_channels when the group omits it); oep pins scans the declared pairs when the wire has channel_groups (a swio wire declared by channel_group was never scanned); tests/test_target_parts.py: its rvswd fixture declared a group with role 1 only (no SWCLK) - now a full role 1 / role 2 group

divergences.spec: 待ちと後始末を含め要求全体のmax_op_msのうちに終える。
divergences.fix: the wait after an attach reset release gets max_op_ms minus the hold_ms already spent; settle_log records the wait actually allowed

divergences.spec: core §2.3: 後続の同じtagも上の検証対象である。（上: 「この probe が扱わない値は rejected unsupported（受け取ったままの tag）」; debug §1: 「0はmalformed。probeのmin_clock_hzより小さければunsupported」）
divergences.fix: every copy of scan max_speed (0 malformed, below min_clock_hz unsupported), idle_clock (unused value unsupported) and attach reset (undeclared channel / hold past max_op_ms unsupported) is checked, the offending copy's tag as received

divergences.spec: core §2.3: 後続の同じtagも上の検証対象である。
divergences.fix: the first-wins cases send valid later copies (still telling the first from the later); new OEP-SCAN-LATER-LOW and IDLE refusals require a later max_speed below min_clock_hz / idle_clock 2 to be unsupported with its tag; the models refuse them

divergences.spec: debug §3 TLV表: attach（rvswd だけ） 0x04 idle_clock / attach 0x05 reset; §5: attachのTLVは0x02 targetsel、0x05 reset; registry [interface.enum.mechanism] = sdi 0 / dmdata 1 / dmseq 2
divergences.fix: the context requires reset = 5 among the selected SPEC attach TLVs instead of exactly {reset: 5}, and the a09fa45 console mechanisms (no none: 255); the test registry now carries a09fa45 attach TLVs and mechanisms
